title: Affiliate Disclosure
metaDescription: How TopProductPick earns money through affiliate links, including the Amazon Associates program.
lede: TopProductPick is reader-supported. Here's exactly how that works.

p: TopProductPick is a participant in the Amazon Services LLC Associates Program, an affiliate advertising program designed to provide a means for sites to earn advertising fees by advertising and linking to Amazon.com. As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
